Seed / refresh audit jobs CSV from bake timings, artifacts, and prior RDS

Source: R/registry_audit_store.R
seed_registry_audit_jobs.Rd

Populates missing study×step rows so the health bar is not empty before the first full portfolio audit. Existing source = "audit" rows are kept; bake/artifact rows only fill gaps (or refresh provisional bake rows).

Usage

seed_registry_audit_jobs(
  registry_root = NULL,
  index = NULL,
  from_rds = TRUE,
  from_bake = TRUE,
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

registry_root

Optional registry root.

index

Optional registry index (default load_index()).

from_rds

If TRUE, migrate rows from audit_latest.rds when present.

from_bake

If TRUE, add provisional ok rows from bake timings / local artifacts for jobs not yet in the CSV.

verbose

Print progress.

Value

Invisibly, list with jobs path, row counts, and summary paths.
